positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: Voted against HR 8294 "Transportation, Housing and Urban Development, and Related agencies Appropriations Act"
Voted for HR 5735 "THRIVE Act"

"Older public housing units are often not up to code, leaving residents exposed to potential hazards," said Congressman Rutherford. "I am proud to join Congresswoman Watson Coleman to reintroduce the bipartisan Public Housing Fire Safety Act to provide grants to public housing authorities as they update older facilities with sprinkler systems. This simple change can prevent unnecessary disasters and ensure residents, their belongings, and our fire rescue teams are kept safe."

"It is inexcusable that some living in public housing have experienced dangerous levels of lead exposure, threatening their health and safety. I am proud to join @RepAlLawsonJr & a bipartisan coalition working to hold HUD accountable for any lead-based hazards in their facilities."
Voted in favor of HR 5735 "THRIVE Act"

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "@POTUS's student loan forgiveness plan undermines the effectiveness of offering an education benefit as a recruiting tool for our military at a time when recruitment levels are already dangerously low. I have joined my colleagues in addressing the harm these handouts will cause."

"Last summer, President Biden announced a plan to cancel student loan debt for borrowers making less than $125k a year. This plan bypasses Congress's authority & exploits language in the 2003 HEROES Act to shift the obligation to repay these loans from borrowers to every American."

"Today, I voted to overturn the Biden Administration’s unlawful student loan bailout. The president's loan forgiveness plan shifts the responsibility of paying student loans from borrowers to all taxpayers & sets a dangerous precedent that encourages irresponsible borrowing."
Voted against H.R. 2547 "Comprehensive Debt Collection Improvement Act"
